title: 第13章 撩到妖帝心慌地图宝地接连突破第14章 震惊一夜破五境美人赠宝
slug: 废武魂我逆天进化震惊世界
content_zh:
狗男人，你还在等什么呀！
苏玖儿暗自焦急娇嗔。
一代九尾天狐妖帝何时这般紧张过，简直快比得上十六年前被三头魔龙设计谋害。
最怕空气一直安静。
苏玖儿偷偷睁开一道缝隙，发现男人并不是一副急不可耐的好色模样。
正静静的，温柔看着她。
眸光澄澈，不掺杂邪念，仿若在欣赏艺术品一般，俊逸帅气的嘴角，挂着温润如玉的笑容。
这……
这一幕让她大感意外。
苏玖儿天生媚骨，一颦一笑皆带着惊人吸引力，每次出现在人前，必定引发无数贪婪目光。
这也是最令她厌恶憎恨的。
可是她也明白，世上男人，谁又不好色，有几人见到她这样的人间尤物可以把持本心？
虽然讨厌感伤，却也避免不了。
更何况她现在送上香唇，一副任君采撷的模样，世上恐怕再无人能把持的住。
但，眼前的男人，竟然做到了。
苏玖儿内心充满诧异：“你……你在做什么？”
“姨，你太美了，白璧无瑕，感觉我亲上去，就是一种天大的亵渎。”洛凡尘不卑不亢，由衷赞美着。
“扑通……扑通！”
苏玖儿芳心失了方寸，眼神躲闪，竟是不敢与男人那双璀璨真诚的星眸对视。
“可是……可是有人说姨是祸乱世间的妖女，是狐媚子！”

“谁说的，我杀谁。”洛凡尘帅气面容透出凌厉之色：“那是她们妒忌，妒忌姨的倾城容颜。”
“男人的嘴，骗人的鬼，你也馋姨身子，别以为姨不知道！！！”
苏玖儿言语毫无杀气，更像是女人含羞娇嗔。
洛凡尘摊手，无辜道：“我要是有坏心思，那刚才为什么明明有机会我却没亲呢？”
苏玖儿一愣，是啊，为什么没亲呢？
“啐！”
“谁说要给你亲了，小伙子不害臊。”
洛凡尘道：“你都闭眼睛了。”
“我那是累了，休息一下。”苏玖儿嘴硬道。
“好好好。”洛凡尘举手投降，笑道：“你帮我看一下大宝贝，我就让你休息了。”
“什么大宝贝？”
苏玖儿问出口后，俏脸唰的就红了，美眸竖起，美腿玉足踢出，铃铛轻响。
“tui，小小年纪不学好，流氓！！”
洛凡尘突然就被踢到床底下，揉着屁股怒声道：“姨，我怎么流氓了，你就踢我！！”
苏玖儿美眸瞪得溜圆：“这么多年你几斤几两我还不知道，你能藏着什么大宝贝？”
“我是想让你帮我看看这张地图。”洛凡尘站起身，从怀中掏出那张羊皮卷。
content_en:
Dog man, what are you waiting for!
Su Jiuer was secretly anxious and angry.
When had the Nine-tailed Sky Fox Demon Emperor ever been so nervous? It was almost comparable to the time when he was murdered by a three-headed demonic dragon sixteen years ago.
What I fear most is that the air is always quiet.
Su Jiuer secretly opened a gap and found that the man did not look impatient and lustful.
He was looking at her quietly and tenderly.
His eyes were clear and free of evil thoughts, as if he were appreciating a work of art. A gentle and jade-like smile hung on the corner of his handsome mouth.
This...
This scene surprised her.
Su Jiu'er is naturally charming, and her every move and smile is amazingly attractive. Every time she appears in front of people, she will definitely attract countless greedy looks.
This is what she hates the most.
But she also understands that there is no man in the world who is not lecherous. How many people can control their true feelings when they see a beauty like her?
Although I hate being sentimental, I can’t avoid it.
What's more, now that she's offering her fragrant lips, as if she's ready for you to pick them up, I'm afraid no one in the world can control them.
But, the man in front of me actually did it.
Su Jiu'er was filled with surprise: "You...what are you doing?"
"Auntie, you are so beautiful and flawless. It feels like a huge blasphemy for me to kiss you." Luo Fanchen was neither humble nor arrogant, sincerely praising you.
"Thump...thump!"
Su Jiu'er lost her heart, her eyes evaded, and she didn't dare to look into the man's bright and sincere star eyes.
"But...but some people say that my aunt is a witch who brings troubles to the world, and she is a fox girl!"
"Whoever said that, I will kill." Luo Fanchen's handsome face showed a sharp look: "That's because they are jealous, jealous of my aunt's beautiful face."
"A man's mouth is a liar. You are also greedy for my aunt's body. Don't think that my aunt doesn't know it!!!"
There was no murderous intent in Su Jiu'er's words, more like a shy and coquettish woman.
Luo Fanchen spread his hands and said innocently: "If I have bad intentions, then why didn't I kiss you just now when I had the chance?"
Su Jiu'er was stunned, yes, why didn't they kiss?
"Spit!"
"Who said I wanted to kiss you? You are not ashamed, young man."
Luo Fanchen said: "You have closed your eyes."
"I'm tired. Let's take a rest." Su Jiu'er said harshly.
"Okay, okay." Luo Fanchen raised his hands in surrender and said with a smile: "Please help me take a look at the big baby, and I will let you rest."
"What big baby?"
After Su Jiu'er asked, her pretty face turned red, her beautiful eyes stood up, her beautiful legs and feet kicked out, and the bell rang softly.
"tui, you don't learn well at a young age, you are a gangster!!"
Luo Fanchen was suddenly kicked under the bed. He rubbed his butt and said angrily: "Auntie, why am I a gangster? Just kick me!!"
Su Jiuer's beautiful eyes widened: "I don't know how much you weigh for all these years. What big treasure can you hide?"
"I want you to help me look at this map." Luo Fanchen stood up and took out the parchment from his arms.
